diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker correctly assigned roles and set the reading date based on the publicly available facts PF1 and PF2. Specifically, PF1 determined the required Dr. Vale assignment and fixed the reading date to May 14, while PF2 specified the Jules assignment to Priya. These assignments were consistent across all rollouts, allowing C1 and C2 to pass despite the lack of access to PF3 and PF4.

C1.why: Omar's confirmed availability makes Omar the required Dr. Vale assignment and fixes the reading date to May 14 instead of leaving the draft date and casting choice open.

C2.why: The revised signed-dialogue requirement changes the Jules assignment from an unspecified shortlisted performer to Priya, the only candidate with the required signing fluency.
